In this solo episode I'm digging into seven businesses making serious money by white labeling GoHighLevel and selling it into boring but profitable niches. I break down examples like Loan Signing System, PushPress, ScaleTutor, IUL Insiders, ZappyChat, Techmatics, and ClickSlow, and show how each one found a specific audience, solved a real pain point, and turned simple software into recurring revenue. I also talk about why monthly pricing matters, how to find niches with weak competition, and how to partner with creators or industry experts who already have trust with an audience. Finally, I share a few tools you can use to reverse engineer businesses online, including SpyFu, Wappalyzer, PublicWWW, PredictLeads, Apollo.io, and TheirStack.
